## Projects Department Health & Safety Standards

Ref: EGY/PRJCTS/HSE/REQs

## 2.4.2.1.1.Emaar Minimum Construction Health & Safety Standards:

- These ConstructionHealth&SafetyMinimumStandards setthemandatoryminimumhealth and safetystandardsthat aretobe adopted andimplementedinorder tomeettherequirementsof the EMAAR Misr Program Health and Safety Policy and Beyond Zero and philosophy.
- This document only provides an outline and overview of the obligations. The detailed and specific health and safetyrequirements are describedinLegislation.

## 2.4.2.1.2. Health and Safety Plan:

- A Program Partners shall prepare a Health and Safety Plan (HSP) covering all activities relevant to their Works. The HSP is to focus on contract-specific arrangements for the management of health andsafety on site and be developedin accordancewith the minimum standards identified within this document. It should define arrangements associated with the following:
- D Leadership and commitment
- Organization, responsibilities, resources, standards and documentation
- C Risk managcmcnt and controls
- Planning and operational controls
- Implemcntation and pcrformancc monitoring
- Audit andreview
- The HSP is to be specific to one Contract or element of the works however if the Program Partner is engaged on multiple contracts then, if they so wish, they can develop an overarching HSP for the EMAAR Misr Program which can be supported by bespoke Supplementary Site or Project HSP's which provide specific and local details in terms of topics such as Organization, Scope of Work, Emergency Response, Welfare arrangements etc.
- > The suitability of the HSP shall be regularly reviewed (at least quarterly) and a formal review is to be carried out annually with the findings submitted to EMAAR Misr.

ProgramPartnersmay not praceedwith anypartoftheworkswithoutan approved Health andSafety

Plan.

## 2.4.2.1.3. Health and Safety Procedures:

- Program Partners shall develop project procedures detailing how health and safety will be adequately managedacrosstheirscopeoftheWorks.
- Project procedures are to cover the design, construction and commissioning phases of the works where appropriate.
- These procedures shall be regularly reviewed and up-dated to reflect changes to work practices anl changes to the site environment.
